reported_success.quote: Although the current study did not replicate the original results

notes: Primary Black-subsample RDD selected using the neutral outcome description. Original locator p.1663 contains both Tables 2 and 3; Table 2 is the primary unadjusted test. Table 3 adjusted estimate is −2.96, p=0.004, and is not mixed into Table 2 values. Requested standardized beta is not printed for this test; retained printed RD estimate without conversion. Replication locator p.4 concerns background/methods rather than numeric results; main analysis is Figure 2 (p.585), with exact estimates/p/effective N in author-provided Table B1. Appendix acquired from primary OSF project as 25 July 2022 author version, not final publisher supplement; its three bandwidths agree with final main-text p.583. Replication measures use fewer/different items and a 1–5 scale, and Black grouping excludes mixed ethnicity, as explicitly documented by authors. These are documented replication-design differences; target_match refers to the located named outcome and main Black-subsample test, not identical operationalization. No standardization or arithmetic conversion performed.
